hu9_3aq.text:
34. 
If the Seller's Solicitors provide the Buyer or his solicitor with a local land charges search a water 
search and/or a mining search prior to completion the Buyer or his solicitor will reimburse the search 
fees to the Seller's solicitors forthwith upon receipt of the searches. 
35. 
If the Seller's Solicitors serve a notice to complete under Standard Condition 6.8 the Buyer will upon 
completion pay to the Seller's solicitors costs of £200.00 and V.A.T. for preparing and serving such 
notice and recalculation of completion statement. 
36. 
The Buyer is required to execute a transfer in the form supplied by the Seller’s Solicitors to the 
Buyer’s Solicitors.  The Buyer shall pay the Seller’s Solicitors fees of £121.00 plus VAT and such 
payment shall be made by bank transfer together with the completion monies to the Seller’s 
Solicitors. Condition G5 of the Common Auction Conditions shall be varied accordingly. 
37. 
In Condition 6.8.2  of the Standard Conditions "five working days" shall be substituted for "ten working 
days".

fee48.text:
19.
The Seller shall be entitled to decline to transfer the Property to any person other than the Buyer. This 
agreement is personal to the Buyer and shall not be capable of assignment without express permission 
from the Seller. Any assignment permitted will be subject to payment towards the Sellers Solicitors 
additional costs of no less than £250 + VAT.
20.
Following exchange of contract, the deposit of 5% or a minimum of £5,000 shall be paid to the Auctioneer 
and shall be held by the Auctioneer as Agents for the Seller and transferred to the Sellers Solicitor.
21.
The Buyer will pay the Buyers Fee on exchange of Contracts being 4.8% inclusive of VAT on the final 
purchase price subject to a minimum of £6,000 inclusive of VAT. 
22.
The Buyer shall not be entitled to delay completion on the grounds that the Seller’s solicitors do not have 
in their possession a Transfer signed by the Seller pending completion.
